initial_prompt: I am so bored. Entertain me.

messages.content: I am so bored. Entertain me.

Boredom! The blank canvas of the soul. I love it. It’s the universe taking a deep breath before doing something ridiculous.

"Entertain you?" No, no, no. I’m not a TV screen; I’m a co-conspirator. We’re going to entertain *each other*.

**Yes, and...** let’s say that your boredom has actually caused a glitch in the Matrix. Because you were staring at the wall so intensely, you accidentally opened a portal.

I am standing on the other side of that portal. I’m wearing a tuxedo made entirely of duct tape and I’m holding a live chicken.

I look at you, panic in my eyes, and shout: **"Don't just sit there! Take the chicken! The Space Pirates are three seconds behind me!"**

Quick—what do you do with the chicken? The clock is ticking!
